search.placeholder: Search name, alias, email or org

badge.outOfFrameHint: This value falls outside the org frame you set. You can extend the frame before adopting it.

chip.notInDirectory: This address isn't in Contacts (no stub will be created)

backfill.progress: Building contacts from your mail · {scanned}/{total} scanned

empty.libraryHint: No manual entry needed. We scan your mail history on first run; people appear as the scan progresses.
empty.searchHint: Try the address prefix, or look in All for robots, lists and hidden addresses.
empty.detail: Pick someone to open their profile
empty.filters: No contacts match the current filters

detail.lockHint: Locked: auto-extraction won’t overwrite this. Click to unlock
detail.editHint: Click a field to edit; edited fields get locked

org.noManager: No manager yet · set one to CC in one click and group by reporting line
org.suggestManager: Manager (inferred from signatures and CC patterns)

profile.title: AI profile
profile.evidenceMissing: That email is gone or was deleted
profile.suggestHint: Adopting writes the value into the identity field and locks it; ignoring only dismisses it this round. AI never edits identity fields directly.
profile.offHint: Once on, the profile agent batch-reads your exchanges to write a profile and propose values from signatures. It only reads mail; it never edits identity fields.
profile.offCta: Enable the profile agent in Agents
profile.thresholdHint: Generated automatically after {min} messages ({n} so far, {need} to go). You can also generate one now.
profile.queued: Threshold met · waiting for the next batch
profile.queuedHint: {n} messages, past the {min} threshold. The profile agent runs in low-frequency batches and will write it next round — or generate it now.
profile.insufficient: Not enough substance for a profile
profile.insufficientHint: We read {n} messages, but they’re mostly forwards and one-line confirmations, so the model declined to write a profile this round. It will retry.
profile.notPerson: Marked as {kind}; no profile is generated. Reclassify as a person if that’s wrong.

merge.title: Merge contacts
merge.sub: Merge “{name}” with another record (usually a changed address)
merge.previewSub: One record with both addresses. History and matters move to the surviving record.
merge.keepThis: Keep this record’s name and identity
merge.pickPrimary: Both addresses kept · pick the primary
merge.conflict: Both records are stakeholders on “{matter}”. You’ll pick one role after merging — we won’t merge roles silently.
merge.danger: There’s no one-click undo. The data is recoverable, but only at the data layer — possible, yet painful. Check the result above first.
merge.futureSuggest: Automatic duplicate suggestions ship later (Phase 3) and will appear on this row, ranked by evidence.
merge.done: Merged into one record with {n} addresses · the other is a tombstone

picker.title: Add stakeholders
picker.sub: {pub} · {title} — pick from contacts, or add by email
picker.searchPlaceholder: Search name, email or org — or paste an address
picker.source: Sorted by exchange volume · from your contacts
picker.createByEmail: Create a contact from this address
picker.emptyHint: Contacts only holds addresses you’ve exchanged mail with. To add someone new, type their address.
picker.syncHint: Names and titles always read from contacts; matters store no copy

toast.hidden: “{name}” hidden · nothing deleted; find it under All
toast.kind: Reclassified as {kind} · sorting and default view follow
toast.markSelf: Marked as you · pinned to the top; there can be only one “me”, the previous one was cleared
toast.former: Marked former · history kept; no longer a default recipient
toast.locked: {field} saved and locked · auto-extraction won’t overwrite
toast.ignored: {field} suggestion dismissed · may return next round
toast.profileRunning: Generating the profile · takes minutes; feel free to leave
toast.profileFailed: Profile refresh failed · model timed out; previous version kept
toast.pickerAdded: {n} stakeholders added · names and titles sync from contacts
toast.pickerCreated: Contact created from {email} and added to the matter
toast.mergeFailed: Merge didn't complete · both records unchanged
toast.adoptedAll: Adopted {n} suggestions and locked those fields
toast.suggestionIgnored: Suggestion dismissed · may return with new evidence
toast.suggestionBlocked: Not adopted · it stays in the queue and nothing was written
toast.bulkBlocked: {count} stopped by a guard · see “Blocked suggestions”
toast.bulkRemaining: {count} still awaiting review · press again to keep going
toast.scanQueued: Governance scan queued · new suggestions land here when it finishes
toast.scanCoalesced: A governance scan is already running · reusing that one, nothing queued twice
toast.promptSaved: System prompt saved · takes effect on the next scan
toast.promptSaveFailed: Could not save the system prompt

agent.title: Contacts agent
agent.subtitle: It reads, it proposes, you confirm
agent.pillTitle: Contacts agent · governance suggestions to review
agent.gotoConfig: Model, schedule, prompt and tool list all live on the “Contacts governance” card in Agents

empty.title: Nothing to review
empty.hint: The agent runs one governance scan a day alongside the incremental mail sync; duplicates, missing fields and dead addresses queue up here.

blocked.title: Blocked suggestions
blocked.hint: An invariant guard stopped these on adoption. They stay in the queue and nothing was written.

agent.queueTruncated: Showing {shown} of {total} · bulk actions apply to every pending suggestion
agent.loadFailed: Could not load the review queue · what you see may be incomplete
agent.scanFailed: The last governance scan failed: {error} · an empty queue does not mean nothing was found

runs.runNote: This only queues a scan — it does not wait for it to finish. The result lands in the history below. Normally it runs once a day alongside the incremental mail sync.
runs.detailRunning: Reading new mail and the directory…
runs.detailDisabled: The governance agent row is disabled — turn it on in Agents, then run it again
runs.detailFailed: This run did not finish; see the error code above
runs.historyEmpty: No governance scan has run yet.
runs.historyLoadFailed: Could not load the scan history · “Last scan” above is still accurate
runs.profileFoot: Last round {last} · next scheduled daily at {hour}:00
runs.profileFootNever: No round today yet · next scheduled daily at {hour}:00
runs.profileLoadFailed: Could not load the profile batch summary
runs.skippedNote: “Not enough evidence” is not a failure: when the traffic is below threshold, or the model judges the material too thin to conclude, it declines to write and the dossier keeps showing the not-generated state.

tools.footnote: See the implementation for exact signatures; the three propose_ tools only write to the review queue, never to the record itself.
tools.governanceOff: The light-write tools are available in the main chat only — the daily governance scan gets no write tool at all.

desc.contact_search: Find people by name, alias, address or org
desc.contact_get: Full dossier (addresses, traffic stats, profile, reporting line)
desc.contact_list_mails: Page through this person's mail ledger
desc.contact_propose_update: Propose a field, a former address or a reclassification — queued for review, never written
desc.contact_propose_merge: Propose a merge; adopting opens the prefilled merge preview
desc.contact_propose_relation: Propose a manager link, queued for review
desc.contact_set_kind: Reclassify person / robot / list — direct write, reversible
desc.contact_mark_former_email: Mark one address as former; no data deleted
desc.contact_update_fields: Edit identity fields directly (name / org / title / phone / notes…); saving also locks the field, always asks
desc.contact_set_manager: Set or clear the manager directly; the server guards against cycles, always asks

prompt.loadFailed: Could not load the prompt · don't save yet, that would overwrite it with an empty draft

text.merge: “{a}” and “{b}” look like the same person
